patterns.content: Use Optional<T> instead of returning null. Optional.of(value), Optional.empty(), orElse(), orElseThrow(). Never return null from a public API.
Records for immutable data (Java 16+): record Point(int x, int y) {} — generates constructor, getters, equals, hashCode, toString automatically.
Stream API for collection processing: list.stream().filter(x -> x > 0).map(String::valueOf).collect(Collectors.toList()). Prefer method references over lambdas when possible.
var for local variable type inference (Java 10+): var items = new ArrayList<String>() — only when type is obvious from right-hand side.
Switch expressions (Java 14+): int result = switch (day) { case MONDAY -> 1; case TUESDAY -> 2; default -> 0; }; — no fall-through risk.
Sealed classes (Java 17+): sealed interface Shape permits Circle, Rectangle {} — exhaustive pattern matching in switch, replaces enum+instanceof chains.
Text blocks for multiline strings (Java 15+): String json = """ { "key": "value" } """; — preserves indentation, no escape hell.
Use List.of(), Map.of(), Set.of() for immutable collections. List.copyOf() to make a defensive copy. Collections.unmodifiableList() is legacy.
String.formatted() replaces String.format(): 'Hello %s'.formatted(name) — cleaner, same semantics.
Pattern matching instanceof (Java 16+): if (obj instanceof String s) { ... } — no separate cast needed.
